The 2027 Indian Premier League was the 20th edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL), a professional Twenty20 (T20) cricket league held in India, which was organised by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). It has been held annually since the first edition in 2008.

The franchises were required to submit their retention lists before 15 November 2026[3] and a total of TBC players were retained ahead of the auction. The auction was held on 16 December 2026 in Goa, India.[4]
